title: Parts of Speech Identification
prompt: Identify the parts of speech in the following sentence: 'Sophie ran to school because she was late.'
hint: Look for verbs, nouns, adjectives, adverbs, pronouns, interjections, conjunctions, and prepositions.
sample: Verb: ran, Noun: Sophie, Pronoun: she, Adjective: late, Preposition: to, Conjunction: because

ja.prompt: 次の文の品詞を識別してください：「ソフィーは遅刻したので学校へ走った。」
ja.hint: 動詞、名詞、形容詞、副詞、代名詞、感嘆詞、接続詞、前置詞を探しましょう。
ja.sample: 動詞：走った、名詞：ソフィー、代名詞：彼女、形容詞：遅刻した、前置詞：へ、接続詞：ので

title: Adverb Identification
prompt: Identify the adverb in the sentence: 'Sophie is always late for school.'

title: Write a Paragraph with All Parts of Speech
prompt: Write a paragraph that includes all eight parts of speech: verb, noun, adjective, adverb, pronoun, interjection, conjunction, and preposition. Post your paragraph in the comments.
hint: Make sure to use each part of speech at least once.
sample: Wow! I quickly ran to the big school because I was late, and my friend was waiting for me under the tree.

ja.prompt: 動詞、名詞、形容詞、副詞、代名詞、感嘆詞、接続詞、前置詞の8つの品詞すべてを含む段落を書いてください。コメント欄に投稿しましょう。
ja.hint: それぞれの品詞を少なくとも一度は使うようにしましょう。
ja.sample: わあ！私は遅刻したので大きな学校へ急いで走り、友達は木の下で待っていました。
